notes:
BETA build - for testing.
- Press modes: a macro can start on a short tap, a double tap or a long press of its key. One key can carry up to three macros this way.
- Exact delays: macro delays are kept to about a millisecond. On for new macros - older macros keep their timing until you switch it on in the editor.
- Windows 11 no longer slows down macro timing while the app sits in the tray.
- Rounded buttons, tray menu in the dark / light look of the app, title bar in the app colours (Windows 11).
